files.title: File:Doo Wop Aquarius Motel NJ.jpg
files.author: Smallbones
files.caption: Aquarius Motel in Wildwood New Jersey in the Doo Wop architectural style. Part of the Wildwoods Shore Resort Historic District, a New jersey HD (not NRHP). On Taylor Street between Atlantic and Ocean Avenues.

files.title: File:Doo Wop Sea Kist Motel NJ.jpg
files.author: Smallbones
files.caption: Sea Kist Motel in Wildwood, New Jersey.  Part of the New Jersey historic district (not NRHP) Wildwoods Shore Resort Historic District.  At the NW corner of Hildreth and Ocean Ave.

files.title: File:Doo Wop Skylark WW NJ.jpg
files.author: Smallbones
files.caption: Skylark Motel in the Wildwoods Shore Resort Historic District a historic district designated by the State of New Jersey.  This motel was built in 1954 on Spicer Street near Atlantic Ave. in Wildwood, NJ
